verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Llama has model cards, safety classifiers (Llama Guard, Prompt Guard) and license/use-policy docs, but none of the citations show the vendor's own docs explicitly enumerating limitations, weaknesses, or failure modes (e.g., context-window limits, hallucination tendencies, language coverage gaps). The only concrete failure-mode observations (short context window, guardrail bypass, non-English refusals, VRAM constraints) come from third-party community posts, not Llama's own documentation, and one probe even shows the docs pages are gated behind an SSO wall, further limiting confirmed vendor self-disclosure.
